alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 29 at 1:21PM PDT until October 30 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 1 PM today to 2 PM
PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents and managers of
infrastructure in the advisory area should prepare for rising
water and take appropriate action to protect life and property.
Highest tides will occur around noon on Friday. Observed high
tides are 1.3 to 1.6 feet above astronomical tide predictions.
